files.rationale: Move B retunes .data-atmosphere from fixed to absolute at the top of the document, one viewport tall, and makes the dot grid visible (1.15px at .18, was 0.65px at .10). Section 39 adds move D, Instrument Serif on the three display lines with an italic on the hero emphasis, and move E, desaturation of the illustrated covers at rest with full colour on hover. The chart cover is excluded.

enabled() gains an onScreen term fed by an IntersectionObserver, so the canvas loop stops once the field scrolls away instead of repainting at 25fps for the whole visit. Pointer coordinates move from viewport-relative to field-relative, which the absolute positioning requires. onScreen defaults to true so a host that never delivers the observation degrades to the previous behaviour.
Instrument Serif joins the existing Google Fonts request, so no new origin or preconnect, and the cache-busting version is bumped.
Same font request and cache-bust. The CV shares both stylesheets.
Next free CSS section number moves to 40 and section 39 is described.
Records the second font family and which elements may use it, the new band and shadow tokens in the public surface, and section 39.
